<p style="font-size: 18px;">
New York City has a well-known public transportation system, used by thousands every day. Unfortunately, not all trains are created equal. The MTA suggests that fare increases will soon be implemented, but with wavering opinions on the efficiency of the train lines, is this appropriate?
</p>

<h3>Composite Score</h3>
We ranked the various subway lines through a composite score analysis based on rider-reported service quality
indicators to compare line color performance across the system. See more information
in the [report tab](proposal.html#composite-score). Hover over each line in this map of New York
City to see how your most-used line ranks among the rest!
